segments.title: Canva now edits whole decks
segments.say: Canva can now change every slide in your deck from one sentence.

segments.title: New: Canva Brush
segments.say: It's called Brush. Canva launched it on October twenty ninth.

segments.title: 3 edits to try
segments.say: Restyle a design, change every page at once, or turn a slide into an Instagram post.
Open a design, pick Brush in Canva AI, and type the change.
segments.text: Change every header to navy and make it bolder.

segments.title: Canva Pro only, for now
segments.say: It's for Canva Pro for now. Canva says more plans are coming soon.
Save this, and follow for one AI update a day.
